Fourteen boarding-party soldiers in sealed combat armor cluster at an external docking collar amidships, tether lines coiled at their belts, weapons held diagonally, each figure body-readable under the collar's flood lamp.

Twenty figures on a paralleling resupply tender wave from an open observation port, their suits showing retroreflective arm stripes, each person body-readable across the two-hundred-meter gap between the vessels.

Five sentries in sealed patrol suits move in staggered formation along the catwalk bridging the twin engine pylons, helmet glow casting small halos, ant-sized against the vast rectangular cross-beam structure.

Eight EVA hull-painters in tandem harnesses roll a thermal coating applicator across the forward bow section, their orange suits vivid against the raw grey metal, body-readable from any close approach angle.

Four drone operators kneel in a semicircle at the top of the aft communications tower, each wearing hand-tracking rigs trailing holographic threads into a swarm of mapping drones, readable at mid-range.

Ninety silhouetted passengers crowd the wide curved windows of the forward observation lounge, dozens pressed palm-flat against the glass, their forms stacked and overlapping, unmistakably human against the starfield beyond.

Four bridge officers cast as sharp body-readable silhouettes behind the forward command canopy, amber instrument glow outlining their helmets and console-draped arms as two lean toward a central holographic plot.
